errors.trigger: Integration docs, blueprint, run object, or local launch command missing
errors.diagnosis: The launch check cannot run without a documented local command and integrated app
errors.rescue_action: List missing inputs and suggest /fab-weave or blueprint repair
errors.user_message: Launch input is missing: {inputs}. Repair it before launching.

errors.trigger: Run is not in verifying state or weave is incomplete
errors.user_message: Run is not ready for launch verification. Run /fab-weave first.

errors.diagnosis: One or more pre-launch checklist items did not pass
errors.rescue_action: Show specific checklist failures and require resolution before retrying
errors.user_message: Pre-launch checklist failed: {failures}. Resolve before retrying.

errors.diagnosis: The operator attempted to deploy externally without explicit gate approval
errors.rescue_action: Halt and require explicit approval before proceeding with external deploy
errors.user_message: External deploy requires explicit approval. Please confirm.

errors.trigger: Local launch command fails or filesystem access fails
errors.diagnosis: The app could not be verified locally
errors.rescue_action: Record a clear error and leave status non-complete
errors.user_message: Local launch failed: {details}. Fix and rerun /fab-launch.

errors.trigger: Candidate run object fails schema validation
errors.diagnosis: Launch verification update would corrupt run state
errors.rescue_action: Show validator output and do not replace fabrica.run.json
errors.user_message: The candidate run state failed validation. No state was written.
